verdict.rationale: Wise Business holds customer financial data, so whether that data can be excluded from AI model training is a fair privacy question for this kind of product. The evidence pack covers only payments, cards, accounts, webhooks and community complaints about account changes, with no mention of AI training opt-outs or data-use policies. Absence of evidence for an applicable capability yields none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
